title: История из Жизни (Речь)
description:
Посмотри на пример. А затем вспомни историю из своей жизни — как ты потерял какую-то вещь (телефон, ключи), используя подсказки ниже, а потом расскажи ее за 60 сек.

Пример:
Yesterday I lost my phone after the last lesson at school. I left it on my desk and I only noticed it when I was at the bus stop. I went back to the classroom and I looked under the chairs and checked every desk, but I could not find it. I asked my classmates and the teacher but nobody saw it.
Luckily, my teacher has found it today and kept it in safe. I have received my phone at last and I am really happy. I have already changed the password and charged the battery. Hooray!
topic: История о том, как я потерял вещь

conditions.label: Расскажи, как это произошло (Past Simple)
conditions.hint: Yesterday I lost my keys. I looked for them everywhere…

conditions.label: Скажи, какой результат сейчас (Present Perfect)
conditions.hint: I have found them today under the sofa! / I have already bought new keys.
